pickipediaverification-desc: Enforces verification workflow for bot/AI edits on PickiPedia
pickipediaverification-bot-needs-propose: Bot edits must include verification markers. Wrap the new claim in <proposed by="YourBot">...</proposed>, or for a template that supports it (Show, Venue, etc.) add |status=proposed. Edits that only remove or rearrange existing content don't need a marker.
pickipediaverification-bot-needs-removal: In this namespace a bot edit may not take a line away, or move it, without proposing that too. Keep the line where it was, or wrap it in <proposed by="YourBot" action="remove">...</proposed>; it stays on the page, struck through, until a person verifies the removal.
verifybotedits-summary: Review and verify edits made by bots
pickipediaverification-proposed-hover: Proposed by $1, a bot. Can you verify it?
pickipediaverification-proposed-hover-an: Proposed by a bot. Can you verify it?
pickipediaverification-removal-hover: $1, a bot, proposes removing this. Can you verify that it goes?
pickipediaverification-removal-hover-ano: A bot proposes removing this. Can you verify that it goes?
